distinctive_features.feature: Central analytics uses Power BI and APIs, with natural-language prompts generating customizable report visualisations.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: School leaders can explore institutional data and create reports without relying solely on predefined dashboards.

distinctive_features.feature: REST and Batch APIs connect a core MIS database to a marketplace of more than 200 partners.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can integrate external learning, payment, facilities and other systems while sharing core data.

distinctive_features.feature: International-school support includes multiple curricula, calendars, time zones, languages and currencies.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: International and multi-campus organisations can accommodate varied local operating requirements.

distinctive_features.feature: Wellbeing records include configurable indicators, care contributors and restricted viewing permissions.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can coordinate pastoral information while limiting access to sensitive student records.

distinctive_features.feature: Data Protection includes consent registers, parental consent and data-subject access request workflows.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Staff can manage privacy-related records and requests within the school information system.

distinctive_features.feature: Branded parent and student progressive web portals provide push notifications and mobile access.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Families and students can access school information across devices without requiring only native apps.

distinctive_features.feature: iFinance supports multi-currency accounting, bank feeds, reconciliation and multi-entity consolidation.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: School groups can manage financial activity across currencies and entities in one finance product.

weaknesses.issue: Review averages are modest, including G2 at 2.5/5 and GetApp and Software Advice at 3.2/5.
Reviewers describe navigation and workflows as clunky or long-winded, including registers, timetabling and reporting.
Reviewers report an ageing interface and limited bulk import/export.
Custom reports may incur extra charges, and reviewers report rigid reporting and download options.
Reviewers report unreliable Email Wizard behaviour.
US reviewers report rigid regional formats and terminology.
Reviewers cite poor support and difficult customisation.
iParent and iStudent reviews include login, loading, crashing and glitch complaints.
No built-in LMS means schools need external learning-platform integrations.
No public price book; pricing is quote-led and third-party annual estimates conflict.

ai_features: Central natural-language Q&A generates report visualisations from user prompts; results can be customised.
pricing_model_summary: No official public rates; quote-led pricing depends on school size, modules, integrations and implementation. Third-party annual estimates conflict.
biggest_strategic_gap: It is a broad school MIS rather than a built-in LMS; schools need external learning platforms, and standards certifications such as OneRoster, LTI and Ed-Fi are undocumented.
